content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Worcester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and credential thresholds for your background. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications before you enroll, ensuring you meet all prerequisites.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Worcester-based instructors deliver real-world scenarios and exam-aligned content over multiple sessions. Attend all classes, participate actively, and retain your completion certificate—you'll need it for your PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35-hour course, apply directly to PMI with proof of education and work experience. Pay the PMI exam fee at application. Our team provides guidance on documentation and submission to keep your application moving forward smoothly.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your exam with Pearson Vue when ready. Test at a local center or via remote proctoring, and bring your confidence backed by structured preparation.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll enter a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteering, and professional involvement. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible workshops to help you stay current and renew your credential on schedule.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
